# Field Journal

An interactive notebook: read local weather and record observations with a per-character counter that survives saving and loading.

## How to play

Enable in a new world to receive the journal. Activate it, choose Record observation or Read weather. Save and reload to check the counter. Craft a replacement from one paper sheet.

Item ID: `ccb_field_journal`; MOD ID: `field_journal`.
Baseline: `0.Ag-Candidate-2026-09-05-0219`, Lua API 1.

An original CCB-maintained teaching MOD, not a third-party community submission.
Compatible with the other examples in this repository. In-game text displays English and Chinese together; it does not assume an external MOD translation loader.
Use a new test world; do not remove item-adding MODs from important saves.
